title: THE WEAPON READOUT SITS ON A PANEL
why: Styling across the HUD (his order of 2026-10-03): the bottom right readout, gun name, ammo, what is stowed, the backpack count and its key, was bare text over the world and hard to read over a bright street. It sits on the same HUD panel as the other boxes now, sized to the widest line. Nothing moved.
now: The gun and ammo readout in the bottom right has a panel behind it, so it reads over any ground.
